streetName.description: The name of the street, avenue, boulevard, etc.

streetNumber.description: The specific numeric or alphanumeric identifier for a property.

unitNumber.description: The unit number within a building or complex.

district.description: The administrative district of the address.

province.description: The province in which the address is located.

postalCode.description: The postal code for the address.

neighborhood.description: A smaller local area, or settlement, often referred to as 'Asentamiento Humano' (Aa.Hh.), 'Urbanización' (Urb.), etc.

block.description: The block number within a neighbourhood or urbanization.

lot.description: The lot number within a block.

establishment.description: The name of the establishment or business at the address.

reference.description: A reference to a local landmark or descriptive location. E.g. 'frente a la plaza', 'al costado de la iglesia', etc.
